credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)
title: Jin's Blade Storm rips across the arena, and the girl who dared him to this duel stands right in its path . . . (highlight)

segments.say: Jin's Blade Storm rips across the arena, and the girl who dared him to this duel stands right in its *path*.
He is furious, but this is no time to *burn* with anger. He still has a mission.
Biological golems are strictly forbidden, so the Zeifls will deny everything. Jin grabs the relic stone as *proof*.
Two guard spells protect the room, one simple, one nasty. Jin picks the *craziest* way through.
He smashes fire and ice together and the whole place goes *boom*. Subtle? Never.
Back home, his sister Luna slaps two brothers to the floor for sending Jin into *Zeifl* land.
Flagbearers fight flagbearers, she snaps, so bullying a kid ten years younger is *pathetic*.
Jin walks into Storm Castle, and Gilly bursts into tears because he came back *alive*.
Then he shows her the heart of a biological *golem*. Murakhan the cat goes pale.
First a Tomb Giant, now this. He keeps the giant to himself. That cat knows too *much*.
Time skips ahead. The twins whisper Jin will become a reserve flagbearer, and he is *thrilled*.
Meanwhile the patriarch races home, because his youngest son keeps dragging him out of the Dark *Sea*.
He hoped Jin would feed his men to a white *werewolf*, but the kid beat it alone. Or did he?
At the gate he spots Jin's new swords. Ran and Vuigo admit it was a deal, and Jin *took* them.
The full story is on our channel.
